benchmark: Current SPTM and IWV ETF holdings proxy union
membership_basis: Union of current SPTM S&P1500 proxy and IWV Russell 3000 ETF holdings proxy; deduplicated by normalized ticker, with CUSIP retained when available. IWV source does not include CUSIPs. Current proxy membership, not point-in-time index constituents. Any separately verified current large/mega-cap screen outside these ETF proxies is stored separately and may expand only the Companyfacts acquisition queue; it is not part of proxy membership, provider weights, benchmark matching, or historical constituents.
